items.hook: The Lady of Lebanon is a 1934 French thriller film directed by Jean Epstein, starring Andrée Spinelly and Jean Murat.
items.body: The narrative is set in Lebanon and follows a web of espionage with clashes between the French and British secret services, with a beautiful young woman at the centre. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Fifty years of Japanese administration of Taiwan formally ends when the Republic of China assumes control.
items.body: Taiwan, officially the Republic of China (ROC), is a country in East Asia comprising primarily the island of Taiwan, formerly known as Formosa, which has an area of 35,808 km2 (13,826 sq mi) and makes up 99% of the land under ROC control. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Battle of Guningtou in the Taiwan Strait begins.
items.body: The Battle of Guningtou (古寧頭之役), also known as the Battle of Kuningtou or the Battle of Kinmen, was fought in October 1949 on the island of Kinmen (Quemoy), located in the Taiwan Strait, during the final stages of the Chinese Civil War. One of those things you can't un-know.
